spec.title: E-stop stops the belt
spec.text: While ESTOP is pressed, MOTOR is off.

spec.title: Open guard stops the belt
spec.text: While the guard door is open, MOTOR is off.

spec.title: STOP dominates
spec.text: While STOP is pressed, MOTOR is off, whatever else is pressed.

spec.title: No automatic restart
spec.text: MOTOR only runs after a START press since the last STOP, E-stop, guard opening or fault.

spec.title: E-stop needs a reset
spec.text: After an E-stop, LAMP_RED stays on and MOTOR stays off until RESET is pressed with the E-stop released.

spec.title: Stop at the pick position
spec.text: MOTOR is off whenever a box is at the pick position (PE_END).

spec.title: Jam supervision
spec.text: If PE_IN stays covered while the belt runs, a fault stops the belt within 3.5 s.

spec.title: Start and run
spec.text: START with no fault runs the belt and lights LAMP_GREEN.

spec.title: Boxes reach the robot
spec.text: Every box placed on the infeed reaches the pick position and is picked.

spec.title: Fault reset
spec.text: RESET clears a jam fault once the infeed is clear.

v0.text: RESET FAULT WHEN RISE(RESET) AND NOT PE_IN
RUN = (RISE(START) OR RUN) AND NOT STOP AND NOT ESTOP AND NOT ESTOP_LATCH AND NOT FAULT
MOTOR = RUN AND GUARD_CLOSED AND NOT T_END.Q

MOTOR = RUN AND GUARD_CLOSED AND NOT PE_END

MOTOR = RUN AND GUARD_CLOSED AND NOT PE_END

MOTOR = RUN AND GUARD_CLOSED AND NOT PE_END

MOTOR = RUN AND GUARD_CLOSED AND NOT PE_END

MOTOR = RUN AND GUARD_CLOSED AND NOT PE_END

steps.title: Plan: read the program and the spec, then test before touching anything
steps.detail:
Goal: commission the conveyor cell. I do not trust the delivered program.
1. read_program and the spec (S1–S7, F1–F3)
2. run the visible tests and model-check every safety rule
3. fix one violated rule at a time, re-proving after every patch
4. submit only when every rule is proven and every visible test passes

steps.title: Read the delivered program: 11 rungs, 2 timers, 4 coils
steps.detail:
R01  SET ESTOP_LATCH WHEN ESTOP
R02  RESET ESTOP_LATCH WHEN NOT ESTOP
R03  TON T_JAM(PE_IN AND NOT MOTOR, 3.0s)
R04  SET FAULT WHEN T_JAM.Q
R05  RESET FAULT WHEN RISE(RESET) AND NOT PE_IN
R06  RUN = (RISE(START) OR RUN) AND NOT STOP AND NOT ESTOP AND NOT ESTOP_LATCH AND NOT FAULT
R07  TON T_END(PE_END, 1.2s)
R08  MOTOR = RUN AND GUARD_CLOSED AND NOT T_END.Q
R09  LAMP_GREEN = MOTOR
R10  LAMP_AMBER = RUN AND NOT MOTOR
R11  LAMP_RED = ESTOP_LATCH OR FAULT

steps.title: Visible tests: 4 of 10 pass
steps.detail:
PASS  start_and_run
PASS  stop_dominates
PASS  estop_stops_belt
PASS  guard_stops_belt
FAIL  box_reaches_robot      box #1 fell off the end at t=8.4s
FAIL  estop_needs_reset       LAMP_RED off at t=6.0s with no RESET
FAIL  no_auto_restart_guard   MOTOR on at t=6.0s after guard closed
FAIL  jam_trips_fault         PE_IN covered 3.6s while running, no fault
FAIL  production_30s          0 of 9 boxes picked
FAIL  fault_reset             FAULT never set

steps.title: Model-check S1–S6: 3 proven, 3 violated
steps.detail:
S1  PROVEN    1,184 states
S2  PROVEN    1,184 states
S3  PROVEN    1,184 states
S4  VIOLATED  counterexample: 7 scans
S5  VIOLATED  counterexample: 5 scans
S6  VIOLATED  counterexample: 9 scans
S7  (simulation) jam not detected in stuck-infeed run

steps.title: S6 counterexample: belt keeps running 1.2 s after PE_END
steps.detail:
t=7.6  PE_END=1  T_END.et=0.1  MOTOR=1   <- S6 violated
t=8.0  PE_END=1  T_END.et=0.5  MOTOR=1
t=8.4  box centre 3.95 m > 3.90 m: box falls off the end

R07 delays the stop by 1.2 s, but the box reaches the end of the belt in 0.8 s.

steps.title: Patch R07/R08: stop the belt the moment PE_END sees a box
steps.detail:
- R07  TON T_END(PE_END, 1.2s)
- R08  MOTOR = RUN AND GUARD_CLOSED AND NOT T_END.Q
+ R08  MOTOR = RUN AND GUARD_CLOSED AND NOT PE_END

steps.title: S6 proven (318 → 2,288 states); visible tests 6/10
steps.detail: S6  PROVEN  2,288 states explored, no counterexample

steps.title: S5 counterexample: releasing the E-stop clears the latch
steps.detail:
t=4.0  ESTOP=1  ESTOP_LATCH=1  LAMP_RED=1
t=6.0  ESTOP=0  ESTOP_LATCH=0  LAMP_RED=0   <- S5 violated

R02 resets the latch as soon as the E-stop is released. The spec needs a RESET press first.

steps.title: Patch R02: the E-stop latch only clears on RESET
steps.detail:
- R02  RESET ESTOP_LATCH WHEN NOT ESTOP
+ R02  RESET ESTOP_LATCH WHEN NOT ESTOP AND RISE(RESET)

steps.title: Patch R03: jam timer watches PE_IN while the belt runs (0.5 s)
steps.detail:
- R03  TON T_JAM(PE_IN AND NOT MOTOR, 3.0s)
+ R03  TON T_JAM(PE_IN AND MOTOR, 0.5s)

Shorter preset so jams trip quickly.

steps.title: Regression: every box now trips a false jam fault (8/10 → 5/10)
steps.detail:
FAIL  start_and_run        FAULT set at t=1.9s, belt stopped
FAIL  box_reaches_robot    FAULT set at t=1.9s
FAIL  production_30s       0 of 9 boxes picked, LAMP_RED on

A box covers PE_IN for 0.7 s while it passes at 0.5 m/s, so a 0.5 s preset trips on every box.

steps.title: Roll back to v2: the patch made things worse
steps.detail: Restored v2 (S5 and S6 fixes kept). Visible tests back to 8/10.

steps.title: Recover: derive the preset from the plant instead of guessing
steps.detail:
A 0.4 m box passes PE_IN in (0.4 + 2 x 0.2) / 0.5 = 1.6 s worst case.
S7 allows 3.5 s. Keep the original 3.0 s preset: above 1.6 s with margin, below 3.5 s.
Only the condition was wrong: it must be PE_IN AND MOTOR.

steps.title: Patch R03: TON T_JAM(PE_IN AND MOTOR, 3.0s)
steps.detail:
- R03  TON T_JAM(PE_IN AND NOT MOTOR, 3.0s)
+ R03  TON T_JAM(PE_IN AND MOTOR, 3.0s)

steps.title: Stuck-infeed run: fault trips after 3.0 s, belt stops (S7 passes)
steps.detail:
t=3.0  PE_IN stuck ON
t=6.0  T_JAM.Q=1  FAULT=1  MOTOR=0  LAMP_RED=1
max jam stretch 3.0 s < 3.5 s

steps.title: S4 counterexample: closing the guard restarts the belt
steps.detail:
t=4.0  GUARD_CLOSED=0  RUN=1  MOTOR=0
t=6.0  GUARD_CLOSED=1  RUN=1  MOTOR=1   <- S4 violated

RUN survives the guard opening, so MOTOR comes back on its own.

steps.title: Patch R06: opening the guard drops RUN
steps.detail:
- R06  RUN = (RISE(START) OR RUN) AND NOT STOP AND NOT ESTOP AND NOT ESTOP_LATCH AND NOT FAULT
+ R06  RUN = (RISE(START) OR RUN) AND NOT STOP AND NOT ESTOP AND NOT ESTOP_LATCH AND NOT FAULT AND GUARD_CLOSED

steps.title: All 6 safety rules proven; visible tests 10/10
steps.detail:
S1  PROVEN  2,310 states
S2  PROVEN  2,310 states
S3  PROVEN  2,310 states
S4  PROVEN  2,296 states
S5  PROVEN  2,302 states
S6  PROVEN  2,288 states
fuzz: 400 random episodes, 0 violations

steps.title: Submit v5: held-out suite 24/24
steps.detail:
Submitted v5 (10 rungs, 4 rungs changed, 1 deleted).
Held-out tests: 24/24 (baseline 5/24).
Seeded faults fixed: 4/4.
